اختتمت (form VIII)

# اِخْتَتَمْتَ (iḵtatamta) /ix.ta.tam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# اِخْتَتَمْتِ (iḵtatamti) /ix.ta.tam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# اِخْتَتَمَتْ (iḵtatamat) /ix.ta.ta.mat/: third-perso
